summary: A rebased PR now clears the head-moved gap. Head movement was judged against the target sha snapshot taken at admission, so after main moved once - even by the operator landing an unrelated PR mid-flight - every evaluation kept telling the agent to rebase onto the new head, forever, no matter how many times it already had; the gap tripwire then escalated a finished commission while its CI ran green. The judgment now compares the PR's live base against the current target: a rebased PR converges, a stale one keeps its gap.
